scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && vitest run
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @caminos/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run db:seed -w @caminos/api
scripts.crear-autor: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run crear-autor -w @caminos/api --
